title: MVB Financial Corp. Declares Fourth Quarter 2026 Dividend
summary: FAIRMONT, W.Va., November 18, 2026--MVB Financial Corp. (NASDAQ: MVBF) ("MVB" or the "Company") today announced that its Board of Directors has declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.17 per share, consistent with the previous quarter’s dividend. The dividend is payable on December 15, 2026, for shareholders of record as of December 1, 2026. This is the fourth quarterly dividend for 2026.
